name: Kortex makes notebooklm more useful
conversation_summary_overview: The comments discuss the practical benefits and use cases of the Kortex extension for NotebookLM, highlighting its ability to manage multiple notebooks, merge sources, import chats from AI tools like Claude and Perplexity, and organize information efficiently. Users appreciate how Kortex enhances NotebookLM's functionality, especially for handling large amounts of data and preserving valuable chat content.
